dedupe_keys.name: a spatio temporal dataset on food flows for four west african cities

description: Hanna Karg and colleagues publish food-flow surveys for Bamako, Bamenda, Ouagadougou and Tamale. The research team, including the University of Kassel and partner institutions, recorded more than 100,000 entries for 46 unprocessed food commodities. Each city's surveys covered about one week in peak-harvest, lean and rainy seasons. Depending on the city, observations include road, rail, boat and air transport, with quantities, origins, destinations and transport modes. Zenodo provides Food_flow_data_v1.csv free under CC BY 4.0 and links the associated Scientific Data paper and processing workflow. These observations can support urban food-supply network models and disruption scenarios. Coverage is limited to seasonal survey windows, not continuous traffic counts; exact field dates require the accompanying documentation. The data describe observed commodity movements, not every dependency in the food system. No related catalogue record is identified by the deposit.
